label: Midday Update
headline: S&P +1.9% at 11:30, VIX -19%, Nasdaq 100 +2.5%, Brent -4.3% to $94.14, DXY -0.45%
stance: AI dip buying and a reported Hormuz proposal drove the morning, not data. The Qatar meeting at noon ET decides whether oil, and the rally, hold into Tuesday's CPI.

trigger.detail: S&P 7,519, +1.92% vs Friday's close at 11:30 ET; VIX 20.7, -19%. Brent -4.25% tripped the oil gate too

scorecard.call: Nasdaq 100 futures flat pre-market: the rebound has not crossed the Pacific.
scorecard.actual: It crossed at the open. Nasdaq 100 +2.5%, US chip index +4.5% at 10:39 ET; S&P +1.9% at 11:30 ET

scorecard.call: WTI $89.70 pre-market; Trump: new strikes highly unlikely if talks progress.
scorecard.actual: Brent $92.96, -5.5% at 9:35 ET on the reported Hormuz terms; $94.14, -4.3% at 11:30 ET

scorecard.call: Nvidia -5.2% pre-market on the board probe of Huang.
scorecard.actual: Held: -5% at 10:39 ET while the chip index rose 4.5%. A single-stock story, not a sector one

bullets: Hormuz terms reported 9:26 ET: Iran reopens the strait, halts tanker attacks. US lifts the blockade, releases $8bn frozen in Qatar. Nuclear program excluded.
Four cabinet members reportedly oppose those terms. Trump and Vance meet the Qatari PM at noon ET; equities are priced for a yes.
Rates did not join: 10y 4.87%, +1.4bp at 11:30 ET; MOVE 88.4, -4.4pts. December hike odds near 80% at 11:20 ET.
DXY 101.84, -0.45% at 11:30 ET; EUR/USD 1.1203, +0.55% at 11:20 ET. The dollar is giving back Friday's +0.8% as oil falls.
Nine of 11 sectors higher at 9:46 ET, discretionary and communication services leading. The chip index, +4.5% at 10:39 ET, led after its worst week since March.

items.head: Broadcom +7.5%, Marvell +5%: the AI chip dip was bought
items.body: Broadcom +7.5% at 10:43 ET after -10% Thursday; Marvell +5% at 9:46 ET. Nvidia -5% at 10:39 ET on the Huang probe, the one large chip name lower.

watch.head: Trump and Vance meet the Qatari PM, noon ET
watch.body: Confirmation or rejection of the Hormuz terms lands mid-session. Brent $94.14 at 11:30 ET; the reported cabinet dissent is the risk.

watch.head: Barkin 12:15 ET, then the 3y auction at 1pm
watch.body: First Fed voice since payrolls with hike odds near 80%. The auction tests a 10y at 4.87% that did not follow equities.
